title: kb_monitor_status returns one panel as JSON, as kbmon.py --json --panel does
goal: kb_monitor_status with panel NAME returns that panel's JSON and an unknown panel is refused naming the valid ones

run:
import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import kb_mcp
def call(a):
 try:return str(kb_mcp.kb_monitor_status(a))
 except Exception as e:return "ERR "+str(e)[:200]
bad=call({"topic":"all","panel":"nopanel"});good=call({"topic":"all","panel":"sessions"})
print(bad[:160],"|",good[:100])
try:json.loads(good);fine=True
except ValueError:fine=False
sys.exit(0 if bad.startswith("ERR") and "sessions" in bad and fine else 1)
